title: Soldier of Fortune II: Gold - single player
fleetres_block:
call "%~dp0FLEETRES.BAT"
> "%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo // written by the launcher at every start - do not edit
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_mode "-1"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_customwidth "%FR_W%"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_customheight "%FR_H%"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_customaspect "1"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_customPixelAspect "1"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_fullscreen "1"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_displayRefresh "%FR_HZ%"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta cg_fov "%FR_FOV%"

vars.GTITLE: Soldier of Fortune II: Gold - single player
vars.GAMEARGS: +set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% +set r_customheight %FR_H% +set r_customaspect 1 +set r_customPixelAspect 1 +set r_fullscreen 1 +set cg_fov %FR_FOV% +set sys_agpmemchecked 1

_note: sys_agpmemchecked 1 ON THE COMMAND LINE (2026-09-29): SoF2.exe asks DirectDraw for AGP (non-local) video memory at startup and shows the 'No AGP memory detected' message box until that cvar is set - measured on .124, whose vcr-kmd reports none. The check runs BEFORE the configs: seta in base/autoexec.cfg did nothing (tried and removed); +set on the command line skipped it. Second round-trip fixture. Two independently hand-written launchers reproducing from one template is what shows the template is not overfitted to Red Faction. RESOLUTION (2026-09-29): r_mode -1 at the panel size, the same fleetres_block and GAMEARGS as JediAcademy.json plus sys_agpmemchecked - SoF2.exe has the -1 branch, verified 1920x1080 on .240; the old mode-index block rested on the sof2mp.exe measurement, whose cause was r_mode's registered minimum, not a missing branch.
